items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: when Duke and Cab Calloway and Fats Waller was out on the road, you couldn't keep us away from the dance hall

ctx.x: So I remember that as a kid -- going to dances and hearing bands.
And, of course, when Duke and Cab Calloway and Fats Waller was out on the road, you couldn't keep us away from the dance hall.
Although I liked to dance when I was younger, I usually wound up standing in front of the bandstand listening to the music.
